beatSourceSpans.INVERT_PREMISE: Every great cut is human psychology—never the software.
beatSourceSpans.CRITICAL_FLAW: When structure, eye-trace, and 60-30-10 color are mathematical, iteration drops tenfold.
beatSourceSpans.EXPERIMENT: The brain reads the cut before the eye finishes moving—that's why the invisible edit wins.
beatSourceSpans.BLOWUP: Ninety percent of what you see is discipline—letting go of what doesn't serve the cut.
beatSourceSpans.RECONSTRUCTION: One hero commands. Zero competing glare. Every node earns its place or it disappears.
beatSourceSpans.TRIUMPH: Great editing isn't software—it's 60 milliseconds of human perception engineered by design.
